    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    ids = data.get('esearchresult', {}).get('idlist', [])

"import urllib.request
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def fetch_pmc_summary(pmid):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=pubmed&id={pmid}&retmode=xml"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        xml_data = resp.read().decode()
    root = ET.fromstring(xml_data)
    abstract = "".join(root.itertext())
    return abstract

pmids = ['38905329', '29273780', '32248742', '27583834']
for p in pmids:
    print(f"=== PMID {p} ===")
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=pubmed&id={p}&retmode=xml"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            xml_data = resp.read().decode()
        root = ET.fromstring(xml_data)
        title = root.find('.//ArticleTitle')
        abstract_texts = root.findall('.//AbstractText')
        print("Title:", title.text if title is not None else "")
        for ab in abstract_texts:
            label = ab.get('Label', '')
            print(f"[{label}] {ab.text}")
    except Exception as e:
        print("Error:", e)
    print("\n")
"

"import urllib.request
import re

url = 'https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=pmc&id=5741639&retmode=xml'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
content = urllib.request.urlopen(req).read().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')

# find mentions of Ser, Thr, Tyr or phosphorylation sites
sites = set(re.findall(r'\b(?:Ser|Thr|Tyr|S|T)\d{2,4}\b', content))
print("Sites found:", sorted(list(sites)))

# find sentences containing phosphorylation
for sentence in content.split('.'):
    if any(s in sentence for s in ['Ser', 'Thr', 'phosphorylat']) and any(k in sentence for k in ['RBOHD', 'DORN1']):
        clean = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', sentence).strip()
        if len(clean) > 30 and len(clean) < 300:
            print("-", clean)
"
